summary: Practise ESF and IFC project screening, action tracking, engagement, and evidence management. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Environmental and social risk management training helps project teams apply the relevant framework to lender-financed projects. It is designed for infrastructure project managers, environmental and social specialists, lenders, and project teams, covering risk screening and classification, Environmental and Social Commitment Plan (ESCP) action tracking, stakeholder engagement, incident escalation, and evidence management. Digital trackers support monitoring responsibilities, due dates, status, and records, while the course distinguishes the World Bank ESF from IFC Performance Standards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who implement, supervise, finance, or advise infrastructure and investment projects subject to environmental and social requirements.
audience: Lender environmental and social risk officers
prerequisites: Prior experience in infrastructure, investment, development-project delivery, environmental and social risk, or lender oversight is recommended. You should be able to work with basic project documents and contribute knowledge of your organization’s project context. No programming is required; spreadsheet familiarity is useful for the digital tracker exercises.
